verdict: Compartment structures the dendrogram and patients do not cluster together: at k=7, 34% of the 157 AOI pairs sharing a patient fall in the same cluster, against a 37% baseline over all pairs, and peak patient ARI is 0.003 against compartment's 0.741. PROJECT_PLAN §6 expected the opposite. Patient similarity is nonetheless real and is not compartment in disguise: across 102 same-patient AOI pairs whose compartments differ, mean rho is 0.425 against 0.318 for different-patient pairs (+0.107). That is the non-independence (1|patient) rests on. TIME-B n = 8.

cross_compartment_patient.note: Restricted to AOI pairs whose compartments differ, so no part of this contrast can be compartment agreement wearing a patient label.

caveats: Correlation is computed on the 2000 HVGs, not all 18,694 genes: over the full transcriptome every AOI pair correlates at ~0.99 and the structure is not visible.
site and compartment are structurally confounded (lymph_node is tumour-only, glial_stroma and normal_control are brain-only), so their ARI curves are not independent of each other.
